messages:
mira: Heads-up: legal approved the v1->v2 deprecation announcement. We need a short partner QA checklist and a minimal migration playbook. Publish target: Mon 14:00 UTC.
devon: I'll audit all sample repos for hardcoded v1 model ids and create a patch list.
ashok: flagging embed dim changes: some legacy embeds go 1536->1024. Devon, please list affected examples.
devon: will do; outputting CSV and PRs for each repo.
sam: suggest adding a tiny compatibility shim in TS examples to ease partner upgrades; include a clear "temporary only" note.
mira: ok but call it out strongly in the guide. Also add rollback steps for Dedicated customers.
docs-bot: PR opened: redwood/docs#5120 by @devon - "partner playbook + snippet fixes" (CI: pending).
ashok: QA: add a docs CI smoke job that runs canonical snippets against staging v1/v2 and reports embed length mismatches.
devon: adding job under docs/ci/migration-matrix.yml.
mira: owners: playbook (mira), sample updates (devon), redirect map (ashok), QA matrix (ashok). Merge timing: once CI green, publish at Monday 14:00 UTC.
